These evil machinations of the Culinaromancer could only be created by someone obsessed with food. Three 'things' are made from loads of hot cakes, bananas and sweets. Beyond not dying, most people struggle not to take a sneaky bite of one of them.

Quest: Recipe for Disaster

Combat: A deadly trio. Flambeed is a fiery foe and you'll need to be wearing ice gloves when attacking to hold on to your weapons. He attacks with melee and magic. Agrith-Na-Na fights with magic and will occasionally teleport you face-to-face. Dessourt deals a mixture of melee, ranged and magic attacks and will occasionally teleport straight to you if you wander (or flee) too far away.
